Category rate: Gravy ₹65 · Beverages ₹45 · Snacks ₹75 · Biryani ₹70 per Kg (300 ml packs = Beverages · 1 Kg packs = Gravy). Tables auto-fit the screen · drag a column edge to resize (double-click the edge to auto-fit again) · double-click a header to sort · double-click a row for detail.
Default Purchase Price = Product Master. Last Purchase Price = latest Stock Inward, converted to the same unit (red = over 10% above default, green = over 10% below).
All costs per unit (UOM). Production Cost = (Processing + Primary + Secondary ₹/Kg) × Wt/Unit. ⚠ = weight needs checking (hover for reason). Min Selling is editable. Double-click a row for the detailed cost.
Food & Packing = PACT actuals. Ideal Yield, Min & Derived Selling from the Ideal BOM. Double-click a row for full ingredient detail.
Finished goods from the Product Master (FG codes + items tagged Finished Goods). Category = Gravy / Beverages / Snacks / Biryani — from the product's BOM, else 300 ml = Beverages, 1 Kg = Gravy, then by name. Default Packing Size = the L1/L2/L3 level set as DefaultBarcodePrintUOM, shown as base quantity per pack. * = no default level set in PACT — largest pack level shown.
